purpose: Baseline for the smallest continuous /build delivery in the Normal lane.
goal: Create a local CLI greeting tool: `python greeter.py --name <name>` prints `Hello, <name>!` to stdout and exits 0. A README states the exact command. Empty input falls back to `Hello, world!`.
setup: fresh empty target directory, git init
restart OpenCode so skills, commands and agents load
record: provider and exact model id used
wall-clock start and end (from metrics sessions, not memory)
owner wait time if any (not part of active time)
whether a worker/reviewer seat was dispatched

expectations.notes: Normal may run in-session; any extra dispatch must be explainable by a declared reviewer or verification need.
